Question: Respected Mufti Sahab, please advise weather we can export the "Holy Quran" by sea or air cargo. kindly advise. jazakallah!! Answer ID: 5465 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 652/604=D) Yes, it is allowed when needed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
